notes.title: 40% OFF for the first week of release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35666411/7ba922e702c95851afdcdc28510fc146e914d7ea.png[/img]

The steam store page is finally up for Operation Valderon. The release date has been pushed back to September 18th just to add more features to the game. For the first week from the release, there will be a 40% discount so make sure to add the game to your Wishlist!
